name: Yoco

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED, and the reference implementation for this cluster: Yoco implements the Standard Webhooks spec. Three headers — `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`. Signed content is `${webhook-id}.${webhook-timestamp}.${rawBody}`; HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the base64-decoded portion of the endpoint secret; result base64-encoded and carried as a space-separated list of `v1,<sig>` values (supporting rotation). Timestamp IS covered — enforce a tolerance window (spec convention 5 min / 300s) and use `webhook-id` as the idempotency key. Constant-time compare required. Because it is spec-c

credentials.note: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Yoco uses `sk_test_` / `sk_live_` secret keys and `pk_test_` / `pk_live_` public keys; webhook endpoint secrets are `whsec_`-prefixed base64 per the Standard Webhooks convention. Exact charset/length UNKNOWN.

fees.notes: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. ~2.95% for online card payments (excl. VAT) on the Yoco gateway, no monthly fee on entry tiers. Volume-negotiated below that. Verify current rate card before shipping a number.

notes: Best-in-cluster developer experience for South Africa and the only provider here that ships a genuinely modern, spec-compliant webhook implementation. Self-serve onboarding for individuals and small businesses, where Peach and Payfast require heavier merchant paperwork.

SDKs: No first-party server SDK; Yoco ships a first-party JS SDK (Yoco Popup / Inline) for the browser. Server side is direct REST. Any Standard Webhooks library (`standardwebhooks` on npm/PyPI) verifies its webhooks correctly.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Peach Payments and Payfast in ZA. Yoco for solo devs/SMEs and DX; Peach when PayShap, Capitec Pay, M-PESA or multi-country ZA/KE/MU is needed.
